{{Current events|year=2018|month=07|day=12|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Disasters and accidents
*[[2018 Japan floods]]
**The death toll from heavy rains in [[Japan]] rises to 209 and 28 missing. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-weather-japan/japan-flood-toll-nears-200-sun-scorches-thousands-battling-thirst-idUSKBN1K20BJ (Reuters)]
*[[2018 Phuket boat capsizing]]
**The death toll from a tourist boat accident off the coast of [[Thailand]]'s [[Phuket Island]] climbs to 46. [https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/se-asia/thailand-suspends-salvage-effort-in-phuket-tourist-boat-disaster-that-killed-46 (''The Straits Time'')]
*At least ten people are killed and many others still missing after a landslide breaks the banks of a natural dam in [[Panjshir Province]], [[Afghanistan]]. [https://www.tolonews.com/index.php/afghanistan/10-people%C2%A0killed-%C2%A0deadly-chain-disasters-%C2%A0panjshir (TOLO News)]
*The [[Artz Pedregal]] shopping centre in [[Mexico City]] collapses. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mexico-collapse/mexico-city-shopping-center-collapses-no-reported-deaths-idUSKBN1K22RE (Reuters)]

;International relations
*[[Iran and state-sponsored terrorism]]
**Argentina petitions Russia to arrest former Iranian foreign minister and [[Ali Khamenei]]'s advisor [[Ali Akbar Velayati]], who is currently in Moscow for a meeting with [[Vladimir Putin]], over his alleged role in the [[AMIA bombing|1994 Jewish center bombing]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/argentina-asks-russia-to-arrest-iran-official-over-1994-jewish-center-bombing/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
*[[List of international presidential trips made by Donald Trump|International presidential visits made by Donald Trump]], [[United Kingdom–United States relations]]
**[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] arrives in the [[UK]] for his presidential trip to the country amid widespread protests. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-44786706 (BBC)]

;Science and technology
*The [[Council of the Haida Nation|Haida Nation]] calls for tighter restrictions around the [[Bowie Seamount#Bowie Seamount Marine Protected Area|Bowie Seamount Marine Protected Area]], a site of an ancient [[submarine volcano]]. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/indigenous/haida-sgann-kinghlas-bowie-seamounts-protected-1.4743418 (CBC)]
